article.body:
Vision-Language Models Reportedly Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers

An arXiv paper dated 28 September 2026 describes vision-language models reading one of two legible typographic layers in an unspecified test environment, rather than a robot performing a physical task. The supplied record gives no robot body, joints, gripper, actuator, payload, or manipulation result. It also provides no training-data description and does not establish whether inference was autonomous, teleoperated, or subject to human oversight. No warehouse,
